headline: Colonials Break Nevish Stalemate as Weathered Expanse Descends Into Ruin
war_summary: The past three hours witnessed dramatic breakthroughs across the northern theater. Along the Nevish Line, Colonial forces shattered the previous stalemate, seizing six strategic strongholds and driving Warden control down to two bastions amid fierce clashes that logged five base transitions and thousands of casualties. Concurrently, devastation engulfed the Weathered Expanse, where ferocious shelling reduced five positions to no-man's-land, leaving each army clinging to just two bases each amidst seven rapid swings in the last two hours. Stonecradle suddenly roared back to life after its earlier lull, producing six sharp base exchanges across World's End and The Reach, consolidating Colonial supremacy at eight bases to one. While Mooring County and Linn of Mercy experienced no new strategic flips in the past two hours, both sectors remain slaughterhouses with casualty rates exceeding two thousand an hour as reinforcements pour into contested perimeters. Meanwhile, the Dead Lands front has cooled perceptibly, shifting the war's primary friction squarely into the volatile northern arc.
